{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "esol_inverse_bulk_ring_transfer_v2",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "long_skeleton_hydrophobic_surface",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_long"},
          "weight": 0.55,
          "rationale": "Source: long SMILES strongly lowered solubility; by the general solubility equation that bulk raises octanol partitioning."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "short_compact_polar_penalty",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_short"},
          "weight": -0.55,
          "rationale": "Source: short SMILES were most soluble. Small solutes expose little apolar surface, depressing logD."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "fused_ring_scaffold_transfer",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_high"},
          "weight": 0.45,
          "rationale": "Highest-weight source role was ring structure. Rigid fused rings add apolar, low-entropy surface favoring octanol."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "carbon_rich_low_heteroatom_core",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_low"},
          "weight": 0.45,
          "rationale": "Heteroatom-poor hydrocarbon skeletons are the classic high-logP regime; broader coverage than the prior length interaction."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.4,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.5,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.18,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.2,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.65,
      "hypothesis": "Transfers the strongest ESOL roles (size, rings) with inverted sign plus a carbon-rich core term. Fails if pool variance comes from ionization or polar functional groups rather than molecular bulk."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "aromatic_pi_surface_with_branch_role_reversal",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "aromatic_pi_partition_surface",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high"},
          "weight": 0.5,
          "rationale": "Aromatic carbon surface partitions favorably into octanol and dominates high-lipophilicity medicinal chemistry space."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "ring_scaffold_bulk",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_high"},
          "weight": 0.35,
          "rationale": "Ring-dense scaffolds add rigid apolar surface; mirrors the highest-confidence source role without relying on length bins."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "branch_role_counter_prior",
          "conditions": {"branch_bin": "branch_high"},
          "weight": -0.4,
          "rationale": "Counter-hypothesis reversing the uncertain rotatable-bond-to-branch role: heavy branching usually marks polar solubilizing side chains."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "halogenated_aromatic_synergy",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high", "halogen_bin": "halogen_mid"},
          "weight": 0.35,
          "rationale": "Moderate halogenation of aromatic rings adds positive Hansch pi surface; broader, less brittle than the rare halogen_high bin."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 2.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.35,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.4,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.12,
      "ucb_weight": 0.55,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 0.9,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.5,
      "hypothesis": "Tests whether aromatic and ring surface, minus branching flexibility, beats size-driven transfer, while reversing the weak branch role. Fails if branching tracks apolar alkyl chains rather than polar substituents."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "esol_inverse_bulk_ring_transfer_v2",
  "lesson": "Development seeds favored the inverted ESOL bulk/ring transfer (mean AUC 87.9) over the halogen-centric partition skill (85.2), and the latter's per-seed spread was wide (80.3-93.7). Narrow bins such as halogen_high (98 of 4200) and strong negative penalties on the majority hetero_high bin appear to waste budget; broad bulk and ring terms with a modest carbon-rich bonus are steadier. Seed counts are small, so this is a preference, not proof of mechanism.",
  "revision_summary": "Retained the better-performing source-grounded skill largely intact, replacing its narrow hetero_low x smiles_long interaction with a single hetero_low term for wider coverage, and easing semantic mass decay slightly. Rebuilt the alternative as a cleaner counter-hypothesis: it drops the aggressive hetero_high penalty and the rare halogen_high rule that coincided with the weaker run, keeps aromatic and ring surface as the mechanistic core, and reverses the low-confidence rotatable-bond-to-branch source role as a negative branching term. Deployment is frozen on the inverted bulk/ring transfer."
}

rules.rationale: Aromatic carbon surface partitions favorably into octanol and dominates high-lipophilicity medicinal chemistry space.
Ring-dense scaffolds add rigid apolar surface; mirrors the highest-confidence source role without relying on length bins.
Counter-hypothesis reversing the uncertain rotatable-bond-to-branch role: heavy branching usually marks polar solubilizing side chains.
Moderate halogenation of aromatic rings adds positive Hansch pi surface; broader, less brittle than the rare halogen_high bin.

skills.hypothesis: Tests whether aromatic and ring surface, minus branching flexibility, beats size-driven transfer, while reversing the weak branch role. Fails if branching tracks apolar alkyl chains rather than polar substituents.

normalized.lesson: Development seeds favored the inverted ESOL bulk/ring transfer (mean AUC 87.9) over the halogen-centric partition skill (85.2), and the latter's per-seed spread was wide (80.3-93.7). Narrow bins such as halogen_high (98 of 4200) and strong negative penalties on the majority hetero_high bin appear to waste budget; broad bulk and ring terms with a modest carbon-rich bonus are steadier. Seed counts are small, so this is a preference, not proof of mechanism.
normalized.revision_summary: Retained the better-performing source-grounded skill largely intact, replacing its narrow hetero_low x smiles_long interaction with a single hetero_low term for wider coverage, and easing semantic mass decay slightly. Rebuilt the alternative as a cleaner counter-hypothesis: it drops the aggressive hetero_high penalty and the rare halogen_high rule that coincided with the weaker run, keeps aromatic and ring surface as the mechanistic core, and reverses the low-confidence rotatable-bond-to-branch source role as a negative branching term. Deployment is frozen on the inverted bulk/ring transfer.
